critique: The fusion of rigid De Stijl aesthetics with marine life creates a bold, surprising composition, utilizing striking primary-colored blocks, thick black outlines, and diagonal striped bands to construct a brilliant neoplastic seascape. However, the soft, continuous gradients on the central whale's body clash with the surrounding Mondrian-inspired flatness; replacing these gradients with hard-edged color blocking or graphic halftone patterns would create a more cohesive visual language.
